name: @gz2016/dsh-plugin-image-picker
description: Adds a file-picker 'attach image' button to the composer toolbar, since DSH's own web client only supports paste and drag-and-drop for image attachments (v1 scope, per its own upstream design notes) - a real gap for touch devices with no drag-and-drop and, on iOS, no clipboard-image paste.
author: ZG2017
